description:
Performance-focused titanium gravel. Exceptional value.

The Enigma Edge MK.I is a titanium gravel frame designed to deliver responsive handling, all-day comfort and versatility across a wide range of terrain. Whether tackling fast gravel routes, rough tracks or mixed-surface adventures, the Edge provides an excellent foundation for a capable gravel bike.

Constructed from 3Al/2.5V titanium, the Edge combines the distinctive ride quality of titanium with modern gravel features, including a T47 threaded bottom bracket, 44mm head tube, semi-internal cable routing and generous tyre clearance up to 50mm.

Finished in beautifully brushed titanium with contrasting satin bead logos, these frames offer the clean, understated appearance that has become synonymous with Enigma.

SAVE 30% – WAS £2,299, NOW £1,609

With the Edge now succeeded by the Enigma Eremos, these remaining MK.I frames offer an opportunity to own a titanium gravel frame at a saving of £690 against the original retail price.

Price is for the frame only. A compatible fork and headset can be supplied separately, or we can build the frame into a complete bicycle to your preferred specification.

Size & Availability

50cm – Only two available.

These frames are available while stocks last. Contact us to discuss compatible components or a complete custom build.
